'''''Evocar''''' was a work written by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Direus'pei]]. It was commissioned by another Hutt, [[Kossak the Younger]] who sought to start a legend of being related to Hutt General [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]], despite the relation being unconfirmed and play unfinished. However he was double-crossed by the playwright who disagreed with the subjugation of the [[Evocii]], [[Direus'pei]] and all copies of the play were then ordered erased by [[Maltorran protoplasm]] only to have a draft be saved by a scribe of the playwright.<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica p4" />
